name: @openuidev/react-components-dev
description: Tests, benches and docs tooling for @openuidev/react-components (fork only, never published)

scripts.test:parity:baseline: node test/browser/parity/extract-baseline.mjs && OPENUI_PARITY_CAPTURE=1 playwright test --grep "matches the #72"
scripts.ci: pnpm --filter @openuidev/react-components run typecheck && pnpm --filter @openuidev/react-components run lint:check && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && pnpm run test && pnpm run format:check
